import "join"

base = from(bucket: "telegraf_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "internal_write")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${host}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["output"] =~ /${outputs:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value", "output"])


bufferSize = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "buffer_size")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["output"])

bufferLimit = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "buffer_limit" )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${inter}, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["output"])

join.left(
    left: bufferSize,
    right: bufferLimit,
    on: (l, r) => (l["_time"] == r["_time"]) and (l["output"] == r["output"]),
    as: (l, r) => ({l with bufferlimit: r._value}),
)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / r.bufferlimit}))
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "output"])
